production_read_only_findings.root_cause: Web-targeted structured Agent mentions could only leave the pending center after an exact chat reply; the Web UI had no explicit handled action.

changes.top_badge: Counts needs_me and waiting_other only; informational oversight remains visible without becoming personal work.
changes.inactive_targets: Pending required replies whose target room membership is inactive are excluded.
changes.web_acknowledgement: An authenticated Web participant can explicitly acknowledge only their own structured mention or agent_request deliveries in the authorized room; one batch uses one transaction and creates no chat message.
changes.query: Exact target replies use the existing reply_to, sender_participant_id composite index through NOT EXISTS instead of materializing every historical reply.
